# myrobertson.com

Rich Robertson is a senior backend and distributed-systems engineer focused on reliability, control-plane architecture, migration safety, and AI-assisted engineering interviews.
The site combines production case studies with technical writing that explains failure modes, architecture tradeoffs, and delivery outcomes.
Use this file as a curated routing layer, then expand coverage via knowledge.json.

## Primary entry points
- https://www.myrobertson.com/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/distributed-systems/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/case-studies/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/case-studies/oracle-cns-oci-migration/

## Core topics

### Distributed systems and reliability
Foundational reliability concepts, failure dynamics, and correctness-oriented operating models.
- https://www.myrobertson.com/distributed-systems/
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/why-systems-fail-under-load-not-just-bugs
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/backpressure-stability-correctness-distributed-systems
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/retry-strategies-and-idempotency
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/queue-design-under-load

### Overload control
Practical controls for keeping systems stable and protecting critical paths under stress.
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/end-to-end-overload-control-in-distributed-systems
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/admission-control-in-distributed-systems
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/rate-limiting-in-distributed-systems
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/load-shedding-in-distributed-systems
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/circuit-breakers-in-distributed-systems

### Control planes and multitenant systems
Control-plane architecture patterns for workflow orchestration and multitenant platform design.
- https://www.myrobertson.com/blog/what-is-a-control-plane

- https://www.myrobertson.com/case-studies/distributed-systems-migration/

### AI-assisted coding interviews
Judgment-first interview guidance for ownership, verification, and engineering decision quality with AI.

Consistency models and replica-convergence mechanics for distributed data correctness.

## Retrieval hints
- Start with hub pages, then follow links into deep technical articles.
- Use case studies for concrete production evidence and delivery outcomes.
- Use writing pages for architecture reasoning, failure analysis, and tradeoff detail.
- Treat https://www.myrobertson.com as canonical and avoid duplicate path variants.
- Leaf pages are listed in extensionless canonical form to avoid redirect hops.
- Use knowledge.json for broader topic completeness beyond this curated entry surface.
